capabilities: Pull and push allowlisted text files (.md, .canvas, .txt)
Load remote images on demand into in-memory blob URLs
Upload pasted or camera images, converting large ones to WebP
Scan for and delete unreferenced remote images
Isolate conflicting mobile edits onto a conflict branch
disambiguation: Not a git client: it moves allowlisted text files through the GitHub/GitLab REST API without cloning the repository.
extras: Initial sync aborts if local text files already exist; desktop use is meant for testing when the vault already uses native git.
problem: Mobile vaults cannot use native git without cloning packfiles and keeping repository images on the device.

relations.evidence: Works with github.com, GitHub Enterprise Server, gitlab.com, and self-hosted GitLab instances.
Works with github.com, GitHub Enterprise Server, gitlab.com, and self-hosted GitLab instances.

requires.name: GitHub or GitLab personal access token

summary: Syncs allowlisted text notes and canvases with a private GitHub or GitLab repository and loads images on demand in memory.
